spec.description:
Autex GreenStuf Thermal Batts are 100% polyester insulation segments engineered
to provide thermal and acoustic performance in residential and commercial
buildings. Manufactured from thermally bonded polyester fibre without chemical
binders or added flame retardants, they are completely safe to touch and install
without protective gear. Pre-cut to fit common timber and steel framed walls,
ceilings, and mid-floor cavities, they will not settle, crumble, or slump over
their 50-year durability life.
features:
User-friendly with no protective
clothing required
100% polyester fibre with zero chemical binders or resins
Fire safe, achieving Group 1 fire classification to AS ISO 9705

Improves
wall sound transmission loss by 5-6 Rw points

Moisture resistant with less
than 0.03% absorption by weight

Naturally resistant to insect and vermin
attack
Manufactured with recycled PET bottles and 100% recyclable

Tested
to AS/NZS 4859.1 for thermal performance

technical.value:
430 mm (450
mm framing centres) and 580 mm (600 mm framing centres)

5 - 6 Rw points increase in
typical cavity wall

Ignitability: 0, Spread of Flame: 0, Heat Evolved: 0,
Smoke Developed: 0-3

< 0.03% by weight
after 4 days at 50°C and 90% RH

spec.fire:
AS 1530.3: Ignitability 0, Spread of Flame 0, Heat Evolved 0, Smoke
Developed 0-3; AS ISO 9705 Group 1 (SMOGRArc < 100 m²/s²)
spec.compliance:
AS/NZS 4859.1, AS 3999; NCC Volume One (Section J JP1, Section F FP5.1) and
Volume Two (Part 2.6 P2.6.1, Part 3.8.6 P2.4.6)
install:
Install in accordance
with AS 3999 and manufacturer instructions

Friction-fit batts between timber
or steel framing members without gaps

Ensure batts are not compressed against
linings to maintain full rated thickness

Tear batts across width by hand or
cut with a sharp serrated knife if trimming is needed

Maintain minimum 50mm
clearance around non-IC rated recessed downlights and flues

In external
walls, ensure batts do not protrude past the frame into cavity drainage space

In ceilings, lay batts flat between ceiling joists and cover top plates at
perimeters
selection_checklist:
Confirm framing centres (450mm centres
require 430mm batts; 600mm centres require 580mm batts)

Confirm stud depth
and cavity thickness (e.g. 70mm, 90mm, or 140mm)

Verify target R-value
required by NCC climate zone or NatHERS energy report

Confirm acoustic
requirements between rooms or floors

Ensure downlight ratings (IC-4 / IC-F)
allow continuous insulation coverage
accessories:
Insulation strap /
wire for overhead or underfloor batts
limitations:
Do not compress batts significantly as this degrades thermal
R-value

Do not cover non-IC rated light fittings or hot flues without proper
clearances

Not designed as an exposed decorative lining; must be enclosed
behind internal wall/ceiling linings

use_cases:
insulating timber-stud external walls during new
home builds for thermal efficiency without itch

acoustic infill in internal
partition walls to eliminate airborne noise between bedrooms and living areas

retrofitting ceiling insulation in residential roof spaces to stop winter heat
loss

mid-floor cavity insulation between storeys to reduce footfall resonance
and temperature loss
not_for:
exposed decorative wall or ceiling lining
without plasterboard covering

direct masonry contact without moisture
barrier
retrieval.rag_summary:
Autex GreenStuf Batts (Autex Batt) are non-toxic, itch-free
thermal and acoustic insulation segments manufactured in Australia and New
Zealand from 100% thermally bonded polyester fibre with recycled PET content.
Pre-cut to 430mm and 580mm widths for standard stud and joist spacings, they
deliver thermal ratings from R1.5 to R4.0 and boost wall acoustic isolation by 5
to 6 Rw points. Free from chemical binders, asbestos, and respirable fibres,
they are safe to handle without protective gear, resistant to moisture and
vermin, and backed by an industry-leading 50-year durability warranty.
